prompts_subtitle: Inspect operation templates, status and revisions.
prompt_empty_body: Prompt configurations are read from the active Runtime for this Scope.
topics_subtitle: Read saved context and conclusions by topic.
select_topic: Select a topic to inspect its exact revision
select_topic_hint: Full detail, publication state and source references appear here.
topic_memory_empty_body: No active Topic Memory matched this query.
scope_switch_hint: Selecting a scope opens its content immediately.
source_unavailable: Source material could not be loaded
source_unavailable_body: The reference remains available. Retry or open another source.
empty_body: Saved handoffs, memories, experiences and skills appear here.
estimate_notice: Only records with fully resolvable source material are compared. Estimated differences do not represent billing savings.
model_note: Includes model calls made by PowerContext. Excludes conversations in AI tools.
unknown_notice: Unreported usage is not zero. Affected totals are also shown as not reported.
negative_notice: Prepared context was longer than its source material in this period. References and context instructions count toward its length.
usage_unavailable_body: Try again later. Saved content remains available.
loading_error: The page could not be loaded. Try again.
compact_estimate_notice: Estimated differences do not represent billing savings.
fresh_body: Save content from a tool connected to PowerContext, then open its scope here.
handoff_empty_body: Saved progress and next actions appear here.
notes_empty_body: Saved constraints, decisions and related information appear here.
methods_empty_body: Saved experiences and skills appear here.
handoff_unavailable_body: Try again later. Memories, experiences and skills remain available.
entry_body: Choose the scope you want to view.
restricted_body: Check your access, then reopen this scope.
failed_body: Try again later or open another scope.
evidence_denied_body: Separate access is required for this source. The experience remains readable.
usage_empty: No usage recorded in this period
usage_empty_body: Choose another period or return home to read saved content.
no_estimates_body: The current data cannot be compared. Reported model usage appears below.
skill_body_unavailable: This skill does not include directly readable instructions.
notes_subtitle: Read saved facts, agreements and decisions.
coverage_partial: Some prepared context is excluded from estimates
coverage_full: All prepared context in this period is included
scope_list_unavailable: The scope list could not be loaded. You can still read the current scope.
error_403: You do not have access to this content.
error_404: This content was not found. Return to the list and select another record.
error_409: The reading conditions have changed. Reopen the list.
error_422: The content format or request parameters could not be read.
error_503: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
login_body: Sign in with an access token for this service.
invalid_token: The token is invalid or authentication is unavailable. Check the token and try again.
scope_viewing_notice: Page navigation changes the scope being viewed. Tool bindings or the default scope determine where content is saved.
experiences_limit: Showing the first 200 experiences. Search to narrow the results.
skills_limit: Showing the first 200 skills. Search to narrow the results.
notes_search_limit: Showing up to 50 results. Refine your keywords to narrow the search.
profile_subtitle: The committed profile in this scope
profile_empty_body: Saved profile content will appear here.
revision_compare_missing: That revision could not be compared.
revision_conflict: The current revision changed. Open it again before retrying.
revision_forbidden: You cannot roll back this artifact.
handoff_rollback_notice: This creates a new revision. It does not mean the previous next action still applies.
revision_same: The content matches the current revision, so rollback is unavailable.
error_410: This collection position has expired. Reopen the first page.
error_413: The content exceeds the download size limit. No attachment was created.
review_effect_prompt: Approval publishes Prompt configuration for future inference. In-flight inference keeps its frozen version. Rollback creates a higher revision.
review_effect_skill: Approval saves the Skill package without installing, executing, or distributing it.
review_effect_handoff: Approval commits a revision without activating the handoff or acknowledging for the receiver.
review_effect_tag: Approval checks the Tag ETag and content baseline together, replacing tags without creating an Artifact revision.
review_unavailable: Evidence unavailable; approval will recheck it.
review_target_unavailable: Target content unavailable; a complete diff cannot be shown.
home_overview_sentence: This scope has {sources} saved sources and {memories} active memories.
home_overview_empty: This scope has no saved sources or artifacts yet. Saved content will appear here.
home_inventory_unavailable: Current inventory could not be loaded. Other loaded content remains available below.
home_sources_basis: Saved in this scope to date
home_pending_notice: {count} candidates await review. Their proposed changes have not been applied.
note_merge_record: This revision records a memory merge. Its inputs are listed in the record references.
note_usage_period: Included in prepared context {count} times this period ({period})
note_source_reference_only: Only the reference is available for this source.
note_sources_empty: No source references were saved for this revision.
note_sources_scope: Sources belong to the revision you are reading.
processing_subtitle: See what happened to each source and what was saved.
processing_links_unavailable: Source relationship lookup is unavailable in this runtime.
processing_no_linked_revisions: No revision directly cites this source. This does not establish that no processing occurred.
processing_links_limit: Only the first 20 revisions are shown here.
processing_linked_scope: Saved revision references establish these relationships. They do not establish execution time, cause, or whether a particular run created new content.
processing_source_history_unknown: The source record does not retain a complete execution history. A saved source alone does not establish success, failure, or no change.
processing_candidate_scope: This candidate reference was saved by the run. Open Review for its current status.
processing_execution_pending: Execution has not finished. No final result is available yet.
processing_inputs_incomplete: The saved input manifest is incomplete.
processing_inputs_unknown: No input manifest was saved for this execution.
processing_inputs_scope: These inputs belong to the execution as a whole. Check each result revision for its own direct sources.
processing_attempts_scope: Shows saved times, attempt count, and final state. Per-attempt times and errors are not reconstructed. Times retain their recorded time zone.
processing_attempts_empty: No automatic processing was recorded for this day.
processing_attempts_coverage: Automatic processing appears in reverse start order. Started means completion is unconfirmed, not that a worker is alive; missing history is never backfilled.
processing_overview_alert: Processing has not succeeded for {count} inputs in this period
processing_overview_alert_one: Processing has not succeeded for {count} input in this period
processing_overview_alert_detail: No successful run is recorded in this period. Open the details to check the cause and saved results.
processing_overview_kpi_delivered_detail: Only deliveries confirmed by successful receipts
processing_overview_funnel_note: Stages count independently in the selected period, not as conversion rates for one input cohort. Delivery requires a successful receipt; adoption uses the latest feedback for each usage record.
processing_overview_pending_detail: These inputs started processing without a confirmed completion; Processing does not mean a worker is alive.
processing_overview_unreported_detail: Adoption is unknown. Open a usage record to add feedback.
processing_overview_attention_empty: Nothing needs attention in this period.
processing_overview_scope_note: Numbers cover recorded history in the current Scope; history outside the window or missing is unknown, not zero. Service health lives under Runtime state.
processing_overview_waiting_title_lower_: At least {count} input still needs processing
processing_overview_kpi_waiting_lower_on: At least {count} more outstanding input (current state)
processing_overview_waiting_title_lower: At least {count} inputs still need processing
processing_overview_waiting_unknown: Some inputs have not been checked for completion
processing_overview_waiting_scan_detail: The scan reached its limit. Open Sources to check the remaining inputs.
processing_overview_waiting_detail: These current inputs have not completed processing and are not covered by attempts in this period. They may have no attempt or an older failed or unconfirmed attempt.
processing_overview_kpi_waiting_lower: At least {count} more outstanding inputs (current state)
processing_account_coverage: Counts cover recorded processing only; history outside the window or missing is unknown, not zero.
processing_summary_coverage: Counts cover recorded processing only; history outside the window or missing is unknown, not zero.
processing_sources_empty: No saved sources in this scope
processing_runs_empty: No refinement or revision tasks have been accepted
processing_sources_coverage: Sources are paged in save order. Check processing results separately. Source save times are not available in the current records.
processing_runs_coverage: Lists created Dream tasks, newest first. For source-to-memory processing, open Automatic processing.
note_search_results: View search results and match evidence
review_subtitle: Check proposed changes and decide whether to save them.
review_reference_details: View exact reference and full record
review_decision_version: This decision applies to candidate version {version}. Version and authority are checked again when saving.
review_edit_notice: Edit the complete candidate data here. Saving creates another pending version for review.
review_read_only: Your current permissions allow viewing this candidate.
review_other_candidates: View other candidates in this filter
review_saved_tags: These tags were saved on approval. This operation did not create a content revision.
review_result_reference_only: Approval was recorded. A result reader is not available on this page.
review_reason_empty: No change reason was saved. Check the content and source material.
review_recorded_baseline: Compared with recorded base revision {revision}; it may no longer be current.
review_extra_fields: View package, merge, and additional data
review_raw_details: View complete proposal and raw diff
review_evidence_empty: No evidence references were saved for this candidate.
review_effect_replace: Approval saves a new content revision. The previous revision remains in history.
review_effect_create: Approval creates content and provides a link to its saved revision.
processing_attempt_conflict: Concurrent change; another attempt is needed
processing_memory_ineligible: Inputs do not enter automatic memory extraction
processing_direct_write: This Source records a direct Artifact write or edit. It does not wait for automatic extraction.
processing_working_note: This working note remains evidence and does not enter ordinary automatic memory extraction.
processing_retained_memory: Open the existing memory retained in this attempt
processing_decision_scope: These model explanations were recorded during processing. Comparisons can make several decisions; published results determine the final changes.
processing_explanation_limit: Only the first 100 comparison explanations were retained. This is not the complete comparison count.
processing_batch_scope: Results belong to this input batch. Each exact memory revision records its own direct evidence.
processing_no_memory_history: No memory processing history is available. Unrecorded legacy processing remains unknown.
processing_memory_history_scope: This section records ordinary Source-to-memory processing. Other Artifact generation and Dream executions have their own records. Missing history does not mean processing never happened.
processing_related_scope: Includes attempts that published this exact revision and later attempts that retained it. Later processing does not rewrite why an older revision was created.
processing_source_excluded: This Source did not enter extraction in this attempt. Results below belong to other inputs in the same batch.
processing_consumption_consumed: Memory consumption progress covers this Source. Saved attempts establish the actual changes and explanations.
processing_consumption_unconsumed: Memory processing has not completed for this Source. Automatic processing requires generation and automatic processing to be enabled.
processing_error_generation_unavailable: Memory generation is not configured or is currently unavailable.
processing_error_model_timeout: The model call timed out. This attempt saved no memory changes.
processing_error_invalid_model_output: The model result failed validation. This attempt saved no memory changes.
processing_error_memory_index_unavailabl: The related-memory search index is unavailable.
processing_error_processing_failed: Processing failed. This attempt saved no memory changes.
processing_error_concurrent_change: Related content changed concurrently. Another attempt is needed.
note_processing_publication: This revision was published by memory processing. Open Related processing records below to inspect its saved result.
processing_related_limit: Only the latest three related records are shown. The revision sources also link to its publication history.
processing_reading_no_candidates: No memory was extracted for saving
processing_reading_ineligible: This Source does not enter automatic extraction
processing_reading_conflict: Content changed; another attempt is needed
processing_reading_reason_direct: A direct write saved this content. It does not need automatic extraction.
processing_reading_pending: Source saved; processing has not completed
processing_reading_reason_unknown: This attempt has no separate explanation. Check the saved result and Source text.
processing_reading_reason_no_candidates: This attempt produced no candidate memories. The original Source remains available below.
processing_reading_reason_held: This attempt held memory writes and published no new memory revisions.
processing_reading_reason_ineligible: These inputs remain evidence and do not enter ordinary automatic memory extraction.
processing_reading_reason_started: The start was recorded, but there is no completion record. It is unknown whether processing is still running.
processing_reading_reason_cancelled: This attempt was cancelled and has no recorded publication result.
processing_reading_reason_conflict: Related content changed during processing. This attempt did not commit its result.
processing_reading_technical: Source identity, citations and full records
processing_reading_excerpt: This is an excerpt. Open the complete content to read more.
processing_reading_batch: This attempt processed {count} Sources together. Results below describe that whole attempt.
home_no_pending_body: View processing results or read saved content.
recent_processing_empty_body: Saved sources are available. Results appear when processing is recorded.
home_change_unreadable: This record could not be read; other content is unaffected.
usage_records_notice: Recorded preparations, delivery receipts and user-reported feedback.
usage_records_empty: No usage records in this period
usage_records_empty_body: Existing totals remain available. Unrecorded historical details cannot be reconstructed.
usage_feedback_notice: Feedback records the reporter’s observation of adoption and usefulness.
usage_delivery_notice: A delivery receipt does not establish adoption of each item.
work_followup_empty: No linked acknowledgement or outcome is recorded.
usage_truncated: This package contains excerpts. Open exact revisions to read complete content.
usage_reason_inference_timeout: An inference timeout reduced retrieval coverage for this preparation.
usage_reason_inference_unavailable: Unavailable inference reduced retrieval coverage for this preparation.
processing_sources_newest: Sources are ordered by descending saved position. Outcomes come from recorded processing.
processing_overview_failure_history_note: Every failed run is retained, including runs followed by a successful retry.
observation_subtitle: Review source text, processing results and failure causes.
observation_stage_link: Open a stage to view records
observation_retrieval_note: A separate retrieval count is unavailable. Open saved preparation and delivery records.
processing_overview_failed_detail: Open failed runs for the stage, cause, and saved results.
runtime_subtitle: Health checks for this service instance, independent of Scope and business counts.
runtime_checks_empty: The health check returned no dependency details.
runtime_boundary: Results cover only checks reported by this instance. They do not establish health for every worker, model call, metric, log, or trace path.
processing_attempts_period_empty: No automatic processing was recorded in this period.
observation_empty_title: No recorded processing or use events in this period
observation_empty_detail: This does not mean that saved sources or memories are empty. Counts use processing history, delivery receipts, and use feedback. Context preparations are not confirmed deliveries.
processing_date_invalid: Choose valid start and end dates, in order, covering at most 92 days.
observation_preparations_unavailable: Preparation aggregates for this window are unavailable
observation_existing_note: Sources and memories are current inventory. Preparations follow the selected dates. A preparation does not establish delivery or adoption; daily totals cannot reconstruct missing details.
observation_missing_details_title: Daily totals are available; event details are missing
observation_missing_details_body: Preparation counts above come from saved daily aggregates. No processing, delivery, or feedback details are recorded in this window; the execution history cannot be reconstructed from totals.
processing_live_unknown: Queue, running, and retry states are not fully available. Live progress cannot be confirmed.
processing_history_unknown: Processing history is unavailable for this period
processing_history_unknown_detail: No processing details were recorded in this period. Saved sources and memories remain available. Missing records do not prove inactivity or successful processing.
processing_results_basis: Sources are counted by unique identity. Memory changes and runs are separate counts, not conversion rates. Unconfirmed completion does not mean a task is still running.
processing_topic_block_reason: The current processing window reached its execution allowance. Review the cause before resuming processing.
processing_topic_positions: Source cursor: {cursor}; source head: {head}. The difference is not a pending-source count.
processing_topic_pending_detail: A processing window is pending. This does not prove that a worker is currently running.
processing_topic_idle_detail: There is no pending Topic Memory processing window.
processing_live_scope: Current state is independent of the date filter. This status covers Topic Memory only.
processing_recent_sources_title: Recent sources and results · all dates
processing_attempt_more_inputs: This run has {count} additional sources not expanded here.
processing_step_no_new_output: This run saved no new memory revisions. See step 2 for the recorded outcome.
processing_step_output_unknown: Execution details are missing. The direct output cannot be confirmed.
processing_step_linked: Saved content that cites this source
processing_output_linked_brief: These items cite this source. The citation does not establish that this run created or updated them.
processing_runs_filtered_empty: No refinement or revision tasks match this status
method_generation_notice: Select evidence to generate a candidate. It becomes active only after approval.
method_generation_empty: No evidence is available. Choose another type or save a source first.
method_generation_no_op: No candidate was generated. You can select different evidence and try again.
method_generation_page_notice: Only selections on this page are submitted. Changing pages resets the selection.
method_generation_selection_required: Select at least one evidence item.
profile_generate_disabled: Profile generation is disabled. Enable it in the profile policy first.
profile_generate_conflict: The profile changed during generation. Please retry.
note_recall_basis: Recorded preparations in this period, across all revisions; each preparation counts once.
home_processing_sentence: {inputs} sources processed · {created} memory creations · {updated} memory updates
home_preparations_empty: No context preparation details are available for this period.
home_topic_attempt_reason: This window reached the automatic retry limit. This explains why retries stopped, not why the first attempt failed.
home_topic_budget_reason: This window reached its model request or token budget. Automatic processing is paused.
home_topic_recorded_reason: The recorded error below blocks this processing window.
home_issue_topic_budget_limit: Model request or token budget reached
home_issue_reason_unknown: The cause was not recorded. The blocked state alone cannot establish it.
home_issue_code_only: An error code was recorded, but no explanation is available.
home_topic_impact: Topic processing cannot continue for this window. Saved content remains readable.
home_topic_check: Check the latest error first. For a model timeout, check model connectivity and response time. Match service logs by blocked time, Scope and error code before restoring processing.
home_failed_diagnosis: These sources have no successful processing record. Open failed records and check the stage, error code and original input. Fix the cause before retrying.
home_unconfirmed_diagnosis: A processing start was recorded without confirmed completion. Check runtime state and service logs for that time before deciding whether it is running or interrupted.
home_topic_model_timeout: The latest model call timed out.
processing_automatic_help: Process new sources, extract and compare memories, and record created, updated, merged or unwritten results. Each row is one processing attempt.
processing_dream_help: Run created Dream tasks to organize content, such as refining experience, deriving skills or revising memories and profiles. Records show each task status and result.
processing_reason_not_recorded: No specific processing reason was recorded.
processing_sources_subtitle: Review saved source text and its processing results.
processing_automatic_subtitle: Review memory processing results and failures for new sources.
processing_dream_subtitle: Review execution status and results for Dream tasks.
processing_history_more_outputs: {count} more items are available in the attempt details.
method_dream_notice: Select saved content to create a background task. Results remain pending review. Track progress in Dream processing.
processing_retry_accepted: Retry accepted. Background processing has been requested; completion is not yet confirmed.
runtime_configuration_source: From this Server’s loaded startup configuration, shared by all Scopes. An enabled setting does not mean a task is running.
runtime_configuration_explicit: On demand through a button or API
runtime_configuration_unavailable: This service instance did not provide runtime configuration.
method_sync_notice: Synchronous generation waits for the model result, then opens review. It does not create a Dream task record.
method_dream_selection_notice: Select content, then start a background task. Track progress in Dream processing; results still require review.
processing_dream_no_output: This run recorded no new output.
processing_dream_more_inputs: {count} additional inputs are listed under references.
processing_dream_source_inputs: This run recorded {count} source references. Expand references to inspect them.
